_about: Master experiment matrix (Future Plan Section 14), minus the depth-camera experiments E5/E6 which are out of scope for this branch. Every experiment inherits `defaults` (the frozen E0 protocol) and changes ONE variable. Run with scripts/future_work/run_experiment.py; compare with scripts/future_work/compare_results.py.

experiments.name: E0_baseline
experiments.description: Frozen baseline: MediaPipe lite, 78-D, whole-clip resampled to 60, deployed temporal-CNN verifier, strict protocol. Also scores every robustness condition (E8).

experiments.name: E0_legacy_enrol
experiments.description: E0 with the original enrolment rule (query clip included in its own claimed signature) -- measures that leakage.

experiments.name: E0_paper_aug
experiments.description: E0 with mirror + 0.8/1.2x speed augmentation, closer to the paper's video augmentations.

experiments.name: E1_mediapipe_full
experiments.description: Pose backend: MediaPipe full model.

experiments.name: E1_mediapipe_heavy
experiments.description: Pose backend: MediaPipe heavy model.

experiments.name: E1_mediapipe_lite_video
experiments.description: Pose backend: MediaPipe lite with VIDEO-mode temporal tracking.

experiments.name: E1_mediapipe_heavy_video
experiments.description: Pose backend: MediaPipe heavy with VIDEO-mode temporal tracking.

experiments.name: E1_mediapipe_lite_2d
experiments.description: Matched 2D control: baseline with z dropped, for comparison with 2D-only detectors.

experiments.name: E1_rtmpose_2d
experiments.description: Pose backend: RTMPose-m Halpe26 (2D), matched 2D descriptor.

experiments.name: E1_vitpose_2d
experiments.description: Pose backend: ViTPose-B coco_25 (2D), matched 2D descriptor.

experiments.name: E1_rtmw3d
experiments.description: Pose backend: RTMW3D keypoints (image x,y + model depth) in the unchanged 78-D descriptor.

experiments.name: E2_mediapipe_lite_world
experiments.description: RGB-only 3D: MediaPipe lite metric world landmarks instead of image landmarks.

experiments.name: E2_mediapipe_heavy_world
experiments.description: RGB-only 3D: MediaPipe heavy world landmarks.

experiments.name: E2_rtmw3d_world
experiments.description: RGB-only 3D: RTMW3D 3D skeleton.

experiments.name: E3_rhythm
experiments.description: Baseline + clip-level rhythm (cadence, stride time/CV, regularity, harmonic ratio, phase synchrony).

experiments.name: E3_frequency
experiments.description: Baseline + harmonic spectra of knee angles, pelvis vertical, heel separation.

experiments.name: E3_phase
experiments.description: Baseline + per-frame left/right gait phase (sin, cos).

experiments.name: E3_rhythm_all
experiments.description: Baseline + rhythm + frequency + phase.

experiments.name: E3_cycle
experiments.description: RQ4: baseline families, gait-cycle-normalised (mean heel-strike-to-heel-strike cycle) instead of whole-clip resampling.

experiments.name: E3_cycle_rhythm_all
experiments.description: Cycle normalisation + all rhythm families.

experiments.name: E3_dtw
experiments.description: Non-learned DTW template matching on the baseline descriptor (speed-invariant alignment).

experiments.name: E4_coords_only
experiments.description: Feature-group decomposition: coordinates only.

experiments.name: E4_coords_angles
experiments.description: Feature-group decomposition: coordinates + angles (no velocity).

experiments.name: E4_acceleration
experiments.description: Baseline + acceleration (torso lengths / s^2).

experiments.name: E4_jerk
experiments.description: Baseline + jerk.

experiments.name: E4_angular_velocity
experiments.description: Baseline + joint angular velocities.

experiments.name: E4_angles_ext
experiments.description: Baseline + trunk lean, pelvic obliquity, shoulder tilt, foot pitch, inter-thigh, shank angles.

experiments.name: E4_angles_3d
experiments.description: Baseline + the six angles computed in 3D.

experiments.name: E4_symmetry
experiments.description: Baseline + per-frame left-right symmetry signals.

experiments.name: E4_foot
experiments.description: Baseline + heel/toe heights and toe vertical velocity.

experiments.name: E4_com
experiments.description: Baseline + centre-of-mass proxy (pelvis sway, trunk vector).

experiments.name: E4_stride
experiments.description: Baseline + step/stride length, width, stance and double-support fractions, foot clearance.

experiments.name: E4_scaled
experiments.description: Baseline with coordinates in torso lengths (distance-invariant).

experiments.name: E4_biomech
experiments.description: Baseline + all biomechanical families.

experiments.name: E4_full
experiments.description: Baseline + all biomechanical and rhythm families.

experiments.name: E4_interpretable
experiments.description: Only interpretable biomechanics/rhythm, no raw coordinates or velocities.

experiments.name: E7_raw_bilstm
experiments.description: Deployed path + BiLSTM encoder comparison.

experiments.name: E7_raw_transformer
experiments.description: Deployed path + Transformer encoder comparison.

experiments.name: E7_raw_stgcn
experiments.description: RQ9: deployed path + skeleton-graph (ST-GCN) encoder comparison.

experiments.name: E7_stgcn_only
experiments.description: RQ9: ST-GCN encoder comparison replacing raw differencing.

experiments.name: E7_raw_freq
experiments.description: RQ5: deployed path + spectral comparison branch.

experiments.name: E7_siamese
experiments.description: Metric learning: shared embedding, cosine-similarity verification.

experiments.name: E8_same_view
experiments.description: Signatures built from the query's own view only.

experiments.name: E8_cross_view_F2S
experiments.description: RQ6: enrol on frontal walks, verify side walks.

experiments.name: E8_cross_view_S2F
experiments.description: RQ6: enrol on side walks, verify frontal walks.

experiments.name: E8_scaled_robustness
experiments.description: Does distance-invariant scaling buy robustness? Same perturbation suite as E0.

experiments.name: E8_full_robustness
experiments.description: Robustness of the full engineered descriptor under the same suite.
